title: Snowy Tweaks
description: Quick mod originally for my pack Harsh Winters which adds QOL recipes related to my pack.
body:
Little mod for my winter survival pack.

Currently adds:

- Smoking rotten flesh to leather
- Cooking powdered snow buckets into water buckets
- Crafting powdered snow from a bucket and 2 snowballs

Feel free to use this mod outside of the pack.
